I feel this is wrong. Because I hate arugula. Not sure why, I love most all greens. Anyway....was there a remarkable taste benefit to you in putting the arugula on the pizza, rather than having the pizza with a side salad?

If you hate arugula you're gonna hate this!

For me the benefit of Salad Pizza over Salad + Pizza is that 1) you are getting a healthy topping- so for each slice you need to get as much greens. 2) the pizza gives you a nice little scope to eat the salad with and 3) you put the pizza in the oven and then top with greens, so they are not cooked in the oven but slightly wilt by being onto of the hot pizza- it gives a slighting different taste then just eating salad alone.

I would recommend trying fresh greens on cooked pizza - if you don't like Arugula find another green that you like :)
